text:
nina: heads up — SCIM deprovision error rate climbed to ~13% at 14:07 UTC. Lots of 403s and a handful of orphaned service accounts in audit. Anyone rotate IAM principals or touch KMS key policies?
charles: I rotated the TF role name for the provisioner at 13:55 to unify naming (arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/scim-provisioner-2026). I didn’t update key policies because keys are supposed to be managed by the secrets team.
nina: can you grab a log snippet from scim-provisioner? We need the exact KMS error text.
charles: here you go: 
```
2026-07-20T14:06:58Z ERROR scim-provisioner deprov.go:128 "failed to decrypt external_id" err="AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555666777888:key/ba12cd34"
2026-07-20T14:07:02Z WARN  scim-provisioner queue: item=svcacc-77 status=decrypt-failed
```
nina: that’s an explicit KMS policy deny. KMS only returns AccessDenied; downstream code treats it as transient and requeues -> leads to orphaned state.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-7744 "SCIM deprov KMS AccessDenied after role rename" — paging eng-platform & secrets
charles: i’ll reach out to secrets to update the key policy. meanwhile should we keep the old role in the policy for a grace window?
nina: yes keep old ARN for 48h. Also we need to restart scim-provisioner after policy change to clear cached KMS contexts; see runbook.
ops-bot: applied key policy patch at 14:12 UTC (kp-change: kp-2026-77) — both scim ARNs now present in AllowScimProvisioner block
charles: restarting deployment: kubectl -n identity rollout restart deployment/scim-provisioner
ops-bot: k8s: deployment/scim-provisioner restarted (rolling) — pods cycling
charles: post-restart logs show decrypts succeed: 
```
2026-07-20T14:15:20Z INFO scim-provisioner deprov.go:174 "decrypt succeeded" item=svcacc-77
2026-07-20T14:15:22Z INFO scim-provisioner deprov.go:201 "deprovision completed" user=svcacc-77
```
nina: run a focused backfill for 13:45–14:12 window and validate no residual failures. Also file follow-ups: update RBAC rename checklist to include KMS policy step, add CI lint to detect principal ARN changes that might affect key policies, and improve correlation ids between SCIM requests and KMS logs.
oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-7744 resolved — root cause: principal rename not added to KMS key policy; remediation: updated policy, restarted scim-provisioner, executed backfill. Follow-ups created.
charles: opened GH-6101 with checklist + links to incident.
nina: thank you — also adding a staging test to simulate principal rotation before prod rotates. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
